notes.title: Beyond the Mountains II Sneak Peek
notes.content:
2024 is just about to wrap up, and I am ready to share an update in regards to the sequel to Beyond the Mountains!

As it turns out, no news is good news! The sequel to Beyond the Mountains is about 70% done. A lot of the core elements are completed, and I'm working on polishing the main map while adding story beats and music.

I have some information and new screenshots below. I hope you enjoy this sneak peek! Be aware that there are some story spoilers below. The screenshots below are all modified to avoid massive spoilers.

[h1]THE BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS II STORY INTRODUCTION[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OH56m6N.png[/img]

[i]Wendy, the main character.[/i]

The sequel starts sixty years after the events of Beyond the Mountains.

A traumatic past event on the neighboring island of Kearbis has forced Queen Tara to send Gavin as an ambassador of Evalon to rule the land.

After decades of ruling Kearbis, Gavin has suddenly ceased all communication to Evalon. The Queen sends Wendy on a secret mission to Kearbis to find out why.

You will be playing the role of Wendy in Beyond the Mountains II. Wendy is a retired seventy-year-old guard who has a few secrets of her own.

[h1]A NEW CONTINENT TO EXPLORE[/h1]

The island of Kearbis is completely different from the island of Evalon. You will explore forests, deserts, marshes, volcanoes, and many more places.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BFWi6Ps.png[/img]

[i]Two train stations.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jL4huZs.png[/img]

[i]Swimming will be a new part of the game play.[/i]

The island of Kearbis is larger and better connected than Evalon's island. Fast travel will be organically unlocked via train tracks. You will also be able to swim and use boats to get to hard to reach areas. 

[h1]LARGER DUNGEONS[/h1]

There are multiple dungeons and even more mini-dungeons in the sequel. The dungeons in this game are substantially larger than the dungeons in the previous game. The first true dungeon in this game is larger than any dungeon in the first game. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VTsuW0Y.png[/img]

[i]One item will allow you to use electricity to power an elevator.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4veSI1a.png[/img]

[i]One item will allow you to hit targets and stun most enemies.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oiiaFEV.png[/img]

[i]Could this be a circus dungeon?[/i]

[h1]GAME PLAY[/h1]

The game play for Beyond the Mountains II is essentially identical to the first game's game play. You will swing a sword, find items, unlock treasures, and discover new paths. This game has many more things to find and rewards for different objects collected.

The sequel will be harder but less frustrating than the first game.

Two items you will collect on your journey are books and train parts.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6kkaPyT.png[/img]

[i]I bet there's something good in there....[/i]

[h1]RELEASE DATE[/h1]

Like the first game, I am building everything from scratch. I wasn't satisfied with the first build of the sequel so I'm taking the time to revamp large portions of it. As a result, Beyond the Mountains II will be delayed until I am happy with it. I think the game will be completed by the end of next year.

I am really trying to create a beautiful sequel that surpasses the first game in every way. I know it will be worth the wait. The game will be a firm sequel to the first game, so be sure to play the original before tackling the sequel!

That's all for now! I hope to share more information in the coming months! You're welcome to ask any questions below and I will try my best to answer them!

Happy holidays!

- Eric

notes.title: The Final Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! The final update for Beyond the Mountains is now live! Here's an abridged list of changes and patches that you can expect in the new update.

[h1]UPDATED SPRITES AND TILESETS IN ALL AREAS[/h1]

I've really improved my pixel art in the last year, and wanted to tastefully update many sprites and tiles in all areas. The new areas blend together a bit better and have consistent theming throughout. Some areas look completely different.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/LWJr7qt.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/LWJr7qt.png[/img][/url]
[i]Updated Old Florasta[/i]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/yoQu6Ue.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/yoQu6Ue.png[/img][/url]
[i]Updated Marbus Shores[/i]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/iB6T7Bb.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/iB6T7Bb.png[/img][/url]
[i]Updated Bryhana[/i]

[h1]FIXED COUNTLESS GLITCHES AND SOFTLOCKS[/h1]

There were hundreds of little glitches that I patched out. Sadly, some very minor graphic glitches still exist as they are baked into the game. They've all been patched for the sequel.

All softlocks have been patched out!

[h1]UPDATED NPC AI[/h1]

Originally, monsters would attack unrelentingly. I've updated MOST monsters to have a neutral buffer before attacking. They also back off a bit! Please note that this is not for every monster!

[h1]UPDATED BOSS FIGHTS[/h1]

I've polished the boss fights to make them a little more interesting! One boss fight is completely different.

[h1]REMOVED HOUSE MUSIC TRANSITIONS[/h1]

I've gotten a lot of great feedback on the music in the game. People weren't big fans of the house music transitions, so I've removed them from the game.

[h1]LESS TEXT FOR MINOR EVENTS[/h1]

To ease the transition between Beyond the Mountains and its upcoming sequel, I've removed a lot of text from minor events, such as when you open a standard treasure chest or open a door. The removal of text creates a smoother game-play experience.

[h1]NO FALL DAMAGE[/h1]

To make the game a bit easier, I've completely removed fall damage from the game.

[h1]REMOVAL OF THE DUMMY RING[/h1]

The dummy ring has been removed from the game. It was causing too many weird glitches. There is a new section that replaces the dummy ring section.

[h1]RUNNING RING TOGGLE[/h1]

The running ring has been switched from a timed event to a toggle.

[h1]LORE POLISH[/h1]

Some events in-game are polished further to ensure a seamless transition to the upcoming sequel.

[h1]THANK YOU![/h1]

This final update should have a tiny asterisk by it, because I anticipate fixing a few glitches here and there. As always, please post any bugs and glitches you may find in the forums.

Thank you so much for playing my game! This was the first game I ever made. It took me four years to make. If you enjoyed it, help me out by leaving a review or telling your friends!

With this, I can finally shift my attention back to the upcoming sequel, which I estimate will be released in Q2 2025!

Happy adventuring!

- Eric

[h1]GAME DETAILS[/h1]

I'll add more details as the game becomes closer to being complete. Here's what I can reveal so far.

1. This sequel takes place 80 years after the first game.
2. You will be playing as a new character. There will be old and new characters in this sequel.
3. This sequel directly ties into the first game.
4. You will be able to swim.
5. This sequel is substantially bigger than the first game. As a reference, the first dungeon in the sequel is larger than the last dungeon from the first game.
6. This sequel takes place on an entirely new continent, with a new (and larger) world map.
7. One item you unlock is a screwdriver.
8. This sequel has a tentative release date of Quarter 1 2025, with a Steam Page and trailer being released on Quarter 3 2024.

[h1]BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS FUTURE PLANS[/h1]

The sequel is infinitely more polished than the original game, and I've learned a lot while working on it. Because both games are made in the same engine, my intention is to polish the original game before releasing the sequel. As the sequel nears completion, I'll be turning my attention to the original game to give it some polish, particularly in the game-play area. The original game will remain free as a teaser for the sequel.

[h1]SOCIAL MEDIA HANDLES[/h1]

I suggest that you follow my social media pages below if you want to be updated more frequently on sequel updates.

[url=https://www.instagram.com/verdlife_games]Instagram[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/verdlife_games/]Twitter[/url]

That's all for now. Talk to you next month!

- Eric

notes.title: Thank You! + Sequel Announcement
notes.content:
I hope you're having a nice week! Here is some information about Beyond the Mountains that you might be interested in.

[h1]BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS IS STABLE[/h1]

Beyond the Mountains is currently stable! There will be no further work on Beyond the Mountains for the near future. The game is done, and all major bugs have been fixed. I will continue to work on bugs as they are reported, so please post on the Steam forums if you find any!

[h1]I AM LOOKING FOR A STEAMPIPE DEVELOPER[/h1]

I am still looking for a steampipe developer to help me compile an installer to make the game natively Steam Deck compatible. This is a paid position. Please contact me if you are able to help me out!

[h1]A SEQUEL TO BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS IS CURRENTLY IN DEVELOPMENT[/h1]

Due to the tremendous feedback and amount of players, I am currently in the process of outlining the sequel to Beyond the Mountains. The game will use the same engine, but will have a different overworld, items, and main character. Without spoiling too much, here are two places you will explore in the upcoming sequel.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CCfUR8c.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/t1K4uza.png[/img]

Both images are proof of concept and will be used to develop the game further.

The sequel is set to be released late 2024. It will be a hard sequel, which means that you will have to play Beyond the Mountains to understand the story of the sequel. More information regarding the sequel will be revealed in the coming months.

Thanks for reading! Enjoy your adventure!

-Eric

notes.title: Update 1.11 is LIVE + I need your help!
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 1.11[/h1]

Update 1.11 is now LIVE. This is a small (8.5mb) update that fixes a lot of small quirks in-game. Installing the update will create a smoother experience for any new play-through. 

Here's a list of the quirks I've fixed (in order of importance):

[olist]
[*]De-buffed Angelo's powers due to insane clipping and game-breaking fun (but added a silly Easter egg for finding him).
[*]Eliminated a minor soft-lock in the Dummy Ring room (and clarified the Dummy Ring powers).
[*]By request, added another regen pool in the mountains that is unlocked after finding the first scroll.
[*]Stairs are more predictable. While working on my game, I enjoyed the unpredictability of what was next to come while taking the stairs. I've since learned that I'm independent in that thought. As a result, I've patched many stairs to have more predictable pathways.
[*]Initially, the element fork and magnet had a .5 second delay before the effect worked. This delay has been removed, leading to a smoother game experience.
[*]The coral cave does not require the melodica anymore.
[*]Some sequences have been polished.
[*]Collision errors have been fixed (various overworld and shovel collision removals).
[*]Enemies don't clip through trees anymore.
[*]Eliminated some sword graphic bleedthrough when walking over holes.
[*]Many dungeon switches have been modified to ensure consistency.
[/olist]

Special thanks to std::vector for the absolutely insane testing he/she did on the game. You can view some fun glitches std::vector found on the forum.

[h1]I NEED YOUR HELP![/h1]

When I was growing up, I didn't have much spending money. Any game that I could afford would have to last me years. I created Beyond the Mountains with the intention of it never selling above $5.99, because I know what it's like to have little money to dedicate to gaming.

I see a lot of developers create games and abandon them because sales are low. That is not my intention at all. My goal is to create the best $5.99 game I can. I need your help to ensure that Beyond the Mountains is the best game it can be.

Help me out by posting any weird bugs or glitches you have received. You won't hurt my feelings! If you found these glitches, others may have found them, too! This game is only 2 weeks old, but I have created multiple patches to ensure that gameplay is smooth as players adventure their way through the extensive overworld. It would also help to tell me what your computer specs are, if you know them!

Thank you so much! If you're enjoying this game, feel free to write a review or tell a friend! I have a $0 advertising budget, so that would really help out!

-Eric

notes.title: Version 1.1 is LIVE! Please Read Before Playing.
notes.content:
I have a confession. Although I spent 3 years working on Beyond the Mountains, I only expected 5-10 people to play it. I am shocked and delighted that hundreds have enjoyed the game. As stated before, I wrote all the code by myself. Therefore, it's super important that I receive feedback on any possible suggestions/features/bugs that you encounter in-game. Please use the forums for feedback!

[b]YOU MUST START A NEW GAME TO SEE THIS UPDATE. THE CHANGES ARE TOO SIGNIFICANT TO LOAD PROPERLY ON OLD SAVES.[/b]

[h1]SOFT-LOCK GAME FIXES[/h1]

I have fixed 4 potential soft-locks ingame that would inhibit game progress. Special thanks to Sosich and std::vector for finding 2 of them! I really appreciate it! These bugs are rare but it's good to safe-proof these kinds of things.

[h1]EVALON BEAUTIFICATION PROJECT[/h1]

[h2]Pixel-Matching Assets[/h2]
Before, some graphics and textures were stretched out. There were also some nonmatching assets, which created a disjointed look. I have manually fixed most of them to be properly aligned. There are still a few of them that I'm working on. You can view an example of a matching asset below.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ink0tGe.png[/img]

[h2]Caves/Dungeons Beautification[/h2]
I've also added significant layout changes to many dungeons and caves, giving them a more natural and lived-in look. You can view some new changes below. These changes won't affect gameplay, but they make the game look less boxy.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/E6kcyyL.png[/img]
[i]This is the 1.0 map[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f79H06y.png[/img]
[i]This is the 1.1 map[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DiGTtWN.png[/img]
[i]This is the 1.0 map[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/g3KLMUJ.png[/img]
[i]This is the 1.1 map[/i]

[h1]NEW HUD[/h1]

The ugly (in my opinion) HUD has been drastically updated! It can take a beating with different screen sizes, which leads me to my next point.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hMgJe4f.png[/img]
[i]Updated HUD[/i]

[h1]RESIZABLE WINDOWS[/h1]
You can now resize the game to any way you see fit. I'm not sure how well this will work on Steam, but let's give it a shot! The HUD acts kind of funky when you significantly resize the game, but everything should work! Thank you Lugum for the suggestion!

[h1]ONE-BUTTON ITEM SWITCHING[/h1]
You can now switch items at the press of a button (Y)! No more ugly pause screens! Thank you std::vector for the suggestion!

[h1]ABILITY TO TOGGLE SFX VOLUME[/h1]
Including the ability to toggle the SFX volume is like removing eggs from an already cooked cake. It took me a very long time, but I was able to do it! You can use the pause menu (ESC or Start on a controller) to toggle the SFX volume. You can even mute the SFX to enjoy the music! Thank you Godzilla1 for the suggestion.

Speaking of which, I'm not going to include an option to toggle the music. I worked very hard on the music, and I'm proud of it! I won't be offended if you mute the game!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vjJnyb8.png[/img]

[i]New 1.1 SFX options[/i]

[h1]READING SIGNS NOW PAUSES THE GAME[/h1]
Thank you std::vector for the suggestion!

[h1]MAIN MENU GAME MODES CLARIFIED[/h1]
Now, when you start a new game, you can select your game mode from the start. This helps clarify the different kinds of game modes that were hiding in the Options menu.

[h1]MAINTAINED CONSISTENCY FOR VARIOUS FEATURES[/h1]
This sounds kind of boring, and it is. Basically, I made it so most textures have identical behaviors. For example, if you break a rock, it will always act like the same rock, despite its location. This took forever, but it was worth it for consistency. There's still a bit of consistency I have to fix, although all of it is unnoticeable (unless you really have an ear for these things).

[h1]THANK YOU![/h1]

And there you have it! Version 1.1! I HIGHLY SUGGEST that you start a new game to play this definitive version. The game itself is not too long, and I think you'll greatly appreciate these quality of life features.

This game is not my full time job, but it gives me great pleasure to see how many people are enjoying the game. I will continue to work on it until I think it's perfect, so I appreciate your patience!

Once again, PLEASE contact me on the forums if you're having any issues with the game or would like to provide feedback! You won't hurt my feelings! Enjoy the adventure!

- Eric

notes.title: Version 1.1 Will Be Released Later This Week
notes.content:
I want to thank everyone who has given me feedback on my game! As mentioned earlier, I code everything by myself. It's just not possible for me to try every configuration of every possibility. Thanks to you, I have located and fixed every error presented on the Steam forums.

Here's some stuff to look forward to in Version 1.1 (released for free later this week).

[h1]SIGNIFICANT BUG FIX[/h1]

Special thanks to Sosich on the Steam Forums for pointing out this bug. Sosich noticed that there was a game-breaking bug if you were able to obtain the upgraded sword before the fourth dungeon. This bug will be fixed in this update. I am not aware of anyone else who has experienced this glitch, but I wanted to get it patched ASAP. 

[h1]EVALON BEAUTIFICATION PROJECT[/h1]

I have gone through every location in the game and spruced them up with non-gameplay affecting graphics and assets. These assets will not affect the gameplay whatsoever. They just make the game look much prettier! Most caves and dungeons were updated with these assets. Please view some examples below.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UmKSFlW.png[/img]

[i]Added additional details to walls, including cracks and lamps[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vrQ5PfK.png[/img]

[i]More details added to walls to differentiate from floors[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Laq0JQ0.png[/img]

[i]Dungeons and caves now look less game-y and more lived in[/i]

[h1]HUD UPDATED[/h1]

The HUD has been bugging me for a while. A modified version of the HUD will be released with this update. I'd love to hear your feedback on it when it releases! I've made the text and images larger, for a more relaxed experience.

[h1]NEW/UPDATED ACCESSIBILITY OPTIONS[/h1]

You will now be able to modify the sound effects volume on the pause screen. When you start a new game, you will be prompted to select from 4 different game modes. There's Normal (recommended), Hard Mode, Speed Run mode, and Super Easy mode.

[list]
[*]In Hard Mode, you have 5 lives. If you lose those lives, your save file will be permanently deleted.
[*]In Speed Run Mode, you have only 100 minutes to beat the game. Once 100 minutes have passed, your save file will be permanently deleted. To make things harder, there is no in-game timer. Good luck!
[*]In Super Easy Mode, you start the game with an additional 100 HP. This is a great option for those who don't want to seek a challenge.
[/list]

[h1]GENERAL POLISH[/h1]

I've polished some minigames, various sprites and graphics, and changed a few character dialogues. None of these changes will affect the game significantly. This is just general polish.

[h1]THANK YOU![/h1]

Thank you once again for playing my game. I have learned so much while working on my first game. If you have any suggestions or encounter any glitches, do not hesitate to post on the forums! If you've been enjoying the game, feel free to leave a review. Thank you so much, and enjoy the rest of your week!

-Eric
